description.p: PDF Reader is a modern, high-performance Linux PDF viewer designed with security and responsive rendering as top priorities.

ul.li: Process-isolated rendering engine with Linux Landlock and seccomp sandboxing.
Continuous scrolling, multi-page view modes, and smooth zooming.
Fast full-text search with match navigation and keyword highlighting.
True burn-in permanent redactions with irreversible structural sanitization.
Dark mode and reading color themes with shader-based inversion.
Robust reading position remembering across sessions and file moves.

description.p: Initial release with process-isolated rendering, redaction pipeline, and search.
